lessons.title: A Java program speaks
lessons.summary: A program is a set of instructions. Java source code is text that a Java toolchain translates so it can run.
explanation: A program is a set of instructions. Java source code is text that a Java toolchain translates so it can run.
Our example lives in Main.java. public class Main names its container Main; the file name matches this public class. Braces { } group the contents.

public static void main(String[] args) is the conventional entry method used here. Execution starts inside its braces. The launcher supplies args; this first example does not use it. We will unpack method inputs and results later.
System.out.println("Hello") calls a printing method. The quoted text is a string value. println displays it and moves to the next line; the semicolon ends this instruction.
Two print instructions run from top to bottom. Changing their order changes the displayed order, not the words themselves.

lessons.title: Choose numeric primitives and division
lessons.summary: Change the expression to 5.0 / 2, leaving the destination double unchanged. What prints?
